set.body: Roadmap: bd-01KWWWGMETE2R216KQZWVAJKYV. Scope: modules/linalg. Strengthen the typed numeric core without type-level dimension arithmetic. Acceptance: narrow unsafe array/backing constructors to linalg scope or provide explicit fast-path helpers; make QR state valid-by-construction; add lightweight shape/index/options types such as MatrixShape, SquareMatrix, RowIndex, ColIndex, Tolerance, Ridge, Pivoting; replace stringly linear algebra errors with closed roles. Verification: linalgJVM/test and linalgJS/test, then downstream compile slices that depend on linalg.
set.title: Harden linalg boundary types and unsafe access
